label: HEALING

cover.headline: The first week *after a breakup*
cover.sub: 5 small things that help more than you’d think.

points.heading: Expect it to hurt
points.body: Pain after a breakup isn’t weakness. It’s a sign you cared.
points.panel: “This is hard, and I’m allowed to feel it.”

points.heading: Keep the basics going
points.body: Sleep, water, one real meal. Small care keeps you steady.

points.heading: Tell one person
points.body: You don’t have to explain everything. Just don’t carry it alone.
points.panel: “Rough week. Can I call you tonight?”

points.heading: Put the phone somewhere else at night
points.body: Late-night scrolling and texting rarely help. Give yourself some distance.
points.panel: Charge your phone outside the bedroom this week.

points.heading: Do one small kind thing for you
points.body: A walk, a shower, a favorite song. Healing starts very small.
points.panel: Pick one tiny thing that feels like you, and do it today.

close.save: Save this for the hard days.

caption:
The first week after a breakup can feel like walking through fog. Nothing makes it painless, but a few small things can make it a little easier to get through.

You don’t need a plan for your whole future right now. You just need to get through today, gently. Start with one of these.

Save this for the hard days, and follow @roundabloom for more gentle steps.
